name: Roll-balanced compact-bearing rope climber
description: The proven tapered rope drive and powered large front tyres remain. Four tiny printed bearing brackets pin onto the existing rear rails. Two per side support each free axle atx-136,z18.4, moving the stock small rear tyres8mm forward and3.2mm higher. On the approach this gives a slight nose-up stance; on landing it reduces the remaining rear tyre edge step and trailing wheelbase. Each bracket has two pin anchors and a closed free axle bearing; native bushes trap both axles. Additional4.2g trim centres hanging mass, reducing the front tyre height mismatch at the bank. Two broad low plates sit under the outer ballast row; two small top plates complete the lateral balance.
